entries.title: Standard delivery times
entries.content: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days after the order is shipped. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days. Delivery times may be longer during holidays.

entries.title: Tracking an order
entries.content: Once an order ships, a tracking number is sent by email. The tracking number can be entered on the carrier's website to follow the parcel. Tracking updates can take up to 24 hours to appear.

entries.title: Late or lost parcels
entries.content: If a parcel has not arrived 10 business days after shipping, the case must be reviewed by the support team. The customer should provide the order number.

entries.title: Return policy
entries.content: Products can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are unused and in their original packaging. Return shipping costs are paid by the customer unless the item is defective.

entries.title: Refund process
entries.content: After a returned item is received and inspected, refunds are issued to the original payment method. Processing usually takes 5 to 10 business days. Refund approval is handled by the support team.

entries.title: Damaged or defective items
entries.content: If an item arrives damaged or defective, the customer should send photos and the order number. The support team will review the case and propose a replacement or a refund.

entries.title: Cannot log in
entries.content: If login fails, use the 'Forgot password' link on the sign-in page to reset the password by email. Check the spam folder if the email does not arrive within 10 minutes.

entries.title: Device does not turn on
entries.content: If the NovaBuds earbuds do not turn on, place them in the charging case for 30 minutes, then hold the button for 5 seconds. If the problem persists, contact support with the order number.

entries.title: Website or app errors
entries.content: If the website or app shows an error, try refreshing the page, clearing the browser cache, or updating the app to the latest version. If the error continues, describe the steps that cause it.

entries.title: NovaBuds product information
entries.content: NovaBuds are wireless earbuds with up to 8 hours of battery life per charge and 24 hours with the charging case. They are available in black and white and include a 1-year warranty.

entries.title: Payment methods
entries.content: NovaShop accepts major credit cards and PayPal. Payment is charged when the order is confirmed.

entries.title: How complaints are handled
entries.content: Complaints are reviewed by the support team, who aim to reply within 2 business days. Customers can ask to speak with a human agent at any time.

entries.title: Support opening hours
entries.content: The support team is available Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00. Messages sent outside these hours are answered the next business day.
